preconditions.description: The number of wood planks n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= hi <= 10**9 for hi in h)
preconditions.description: Each height hi of the fence planks must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= li <= ri <= n for li, ri in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid indices li and ri within the range of the fence planks.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly q integers, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(count, int) and count >= 0 for count in output)
postconditions.description: Each output count must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(count == sum(1 for l2 in range(1, n+1) if l2 + (ri - li) <= n and all(h[l2 + i - 1] + h[l2 + i - 1] == h[li + i - 1] + h[l2 + i - 1] for i in range(ri - li + 1))) for count, (li, ri) in zip(output, queries))
postconditions.description: Each output count must correctly represent the number of matching pieces for the corresponding query.
